metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the butt walk exercise (🙂), an easy exercise that can give quick one sided back pain relief. 

This exercise works by lengthening and strengthening muscles commonly associated with back pain off to the side. This includes the glutes and quadratus lumborum (QL) muscles.

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
